svg.title: Figure 1. Exact geometric calibration and threshold comparison
svg.desc: Recomputed from Equations 4 and 7. D grows strictly to the one-sided limit 2 at escape. D equals 1 at E = 9/64. A fixed alpha of 1 differs from adaptive alpha(E) = 0.5 D(E). No transport claim is made.
svg.text: The open endpoints denote one-sided limits. E = 1/6 is outside the bounded-well theorem. Recomputed companion figure.
